title: Will A Matte Screen Protector Ruin Your Phone's Display? - BGR
summary: While there's an argument to be made that screen protectors are outdated , a good matte screen protector can actually make your phone's display feel better to use. But there's a catch: Not all matte screen protectors are created equal.
